Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Operational Care Specialist position at Kuehne+Nagel in Antwerp. With a background in logistics at Katoen Natie and a strong technical foundation in web development and data management, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your Sea Logistics team.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer, I manage end-to-end processes, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in a fast-paced environment. My experience at Katoen Natie taught me the importance of precision and reliability in logistics operations. I am highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with data and systems, which I believe are essential for coordinating reefer shipments and managing documentation.

I am fluent in English, have a working knowledge of Dutch (B1), and am eager to develop my skills in sea freight. I am based in Zwijndrecht, close to Antwerp, and am ready to take on the challenges of this role.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,

Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Operational Care Specialist position at Kuehne+Nagel in Antwerp. With a background in logistics and a strong technical foundation, I am confident in my ability to contribute to your Sea Logistics team and ensure the smooth execution of reefer export shipments.

During my time at Katoen Natie, I gained hands-on experience in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment, where accuracy and efficiency were paramount. This role taught me the importance of maintaining an overview, managing workload effectively, and meeting tight deadlines—skills that are directly relevant to the Operational Care Specialist role. I am accustomed to working with data and systems, ensuring transparency and quality in every step of the process.

In my current position as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage end-to-end projects, from planning to execution, and I am responsible for maintaining high standards of quality and compliance. My technical background, including front-end development and data management, has equipped me with strong analytical and problem-solving skills. I am comfortable with documentation and attention to detail, which are essential for preparing shipping documents and ensuring regulatory compliance.

I am fluent in English and have a working knowledge of Dutch (B1), with a willingness to improve. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am eager to bring my organizational skills and performance-driven mindset to Kuehne+Nagel. I am particularly drawn to the company's global impact and the opportunity to contribute to meaningful logistics solutions.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can add value to your team.

Sincerely,
